scope: Read-only round3 evidence audit and exact arithmetic on saved records; zero new solver/E0/E1/E2/Step2/Step3 calls. No portfolio selection.

preparation.scope: one-off spec, Git source and frozen official hash preflight; before batch budget T0; no graph algorithm/solver/evaluator calls

saved_preflight.scope: format and available bytes only; no solver/evaluator execution or production write

feed.scope: saved local schema/available-bytes preflight only, not central acceptance or Git-commit preflight

definitions.compute_load: sum(max(1, original cycles)) of eligible operations assigned by the saved plan, grouped by original pipe
definitions.busy_cycles: sum(end-start) on the final official P2 per_core_timeline, not Step3 local_makespan
definitions.internal_idle: last_end-first_start-busy; includes every internal gap regardless of cause
definitions.idle_over_makespan: batch graph Makespan minus pipe busy, including leading/trailing idle
definitions.copy_bytes: reconstructed endpoint and cross-core copies from original graph and saved placement; zero spill checked; aggregate equals official result
definitions.copy_busy_minus_exclusive_work: sum observed copy durations minus sum(max(1,ceil(size/60))); overlap across cores means this is not global DDR wall
definitions.causality_limit: an observed gap or delayed COPY alone does not prove one specific priority/memory/dependency cause; no counterfactual scoring was run

solver_stdout.scope: Exact connected scalar partition only; DFS priority; official P2 execution untested
